subject: Data Engineering
title: Cloud-Native Workflow Services
description: A micro-lesson that makes Cloud-Native Workflow Services usable.

hook.text: AWS Step Functions, Azure Data Factory, and GCP Workflows orchestrate without any open-source tool at all.

buildup.text: Cloud-native orchestrators integrate deeply with their provider's services: Lambda, S3, BigQuery, and more.

discovery.text: They offer visual builders, automatic retry policies, and pay-per-execution pricing with no idle costs.

twist.text: Cloud-native means cloud-locked. Your workflows can't move to another provider without a rewrite.

climax.text: For teams fully committed to one cloud, native orchestrators are simpler. For portability, stick with Airflow.

punchline.text: Native is simpler. Open source is portable. Choose your priority.

quiz.question: What is the main drawback of cloud-native workflow services?
options: They lock you into a single cloud provider
They are more expensive than Airflow
